data.name: Imen
data.long_meaning: The name Imen is derived from the Arabic word 'an-Nun' which means 'a river'. It is a beautiful and unique name for a baby girl, evoking images of calm and serene bodies of water. The name Imen is often used in the Islamic world, and is a popular choice for parents seeking a name with deep spiritual meaning and a connection to nature.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Imen is believed to be a reflection of the divine power and wisdom of Allah, the source of all life-giving water. It is a reminder of the importance of staying connected to the natural world and seeking inner peace and tranquility.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Imen carries the energy of the number 9, which represents completion, endings, and new beginnings. It is a powerful and transformative name, encouraging the bearer to take risks and make bold decisions in order to achieve their goals and fulfill their destiny.

in_urdu.name: ایمن

in_hindi.name: इमेन
